record.title: Non-admin managers can issue on-screen Sign-In QR tokens for verified-email, live-phone, and cross-project accounts to take over device sessions and evict active phones
record.description: POST /api/v1/users/<user_id>/sign-in-qr (app/routes/api/users.py:151-166) delegates authorization and token issuance to app/services/sign_in_qr_service.py:issue (lines 176-237) and may_issue (lines 118-130). Unlike 8-character mobile sign-in codes in app/services/mobile_sign_in_service.py (may_issue_code at lines 118-152, issuable_user_ids at lines 197-228, and may_issue_code_from_data_management at lines 293-312), sign_in_qr_service omits three anti-takeover guards required by docs/policy/mobile-sign-in.md sections 3 and 8 (lines 186-210 and 418-425): (1) issue() allows delivery='show' for non-admin callers (project_pi, data_manager, and unit site_pi In-charge) even when user.email_verified is True, returning the plaintext token ('code': token) in the HTTP response (lines 232-237) instead of restricting on-screen QR delivery for verified-email accounts to admins or email-only delivery; (2) may_issue() never checks _live_phone(user_id), allowing a non-admin manager to issue and redeem a QR token at POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in-qr/redeem (app/routes/api/auth.py:277-316 -> app/services/sign_in_qr_service.py:305-372) to open an authenticated device bearer session as a collector who is already signed in on a phone and even decommission their active phone via replace_device_id (line 350 -> device_auth_service.check_device_slot at lines 726-789); (3) may_issue() ignores MapProjectMember (_outside_member), allowing a data manager who looks up an unplaced member of another project via GET /data-management/api/users/lookup and grants them a collector role via POST /data-management/api/access-grants to immediately issue and redeem a Sign-In QR for that account.
record.claimed_root_cause: app/services/sign_in_qr_service.py:may_issue (lines 118-130) and issue (lines 176-237) check only whether the target user is eligible for a collector project and holds at least one active grant with no active grant outside authz.grant_list_filter(actor, _grants=grants), omitting the non-admin delivery='show' restriction for verified-email accounts, the sa.not_(_live_phone(user_id)) guard, and the sa.not_(_outside_member(user_id, projects)) guard enforced in app/services/mobile_sign_in_service.py.

trace.description: POST /api/v1/users/<user_id>/sign-in-qr accepts delivery ('show' by default) from any authenticated admin, project_pi, or data_manager (including unit site_pi) and calls sign_in_qr.issue at line 161.

may_issue(actor, user_id) checks only that the target has at least one active grant and no active grant outside authz.grant_list_filter(actor, _grants=grants), without checking verified email, _live_phone, or _outside_member.

issue(actor, user_id, delivery) verifies may_issue and eligible_project, checks user.email_verified only when delivery == 'email' (line 191), and returns the raw Sign-In QR token ('code': token) in the HTTP response when delivery == 'show' (lines 232-237).
POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in-qr/redeem accepts the raw token and optional replace_device_id without prior authentication and calls sign_in_qr.redeem at line 295.

redeem() calls devices.check_device_slot(user, replace_device_id=replace_device_id) (which can decommission an active phone at the 3-device cap) and then enrols a new device (line 362) and opens an authenticated device bearer session for the target user (line 367).

evidence.description: may_issue() checks only active grants against authz.grant_list_filter(actor) and omits _live_phone, _outside_member, and verified-email checks.

issue() enforces user.email_verified only when delivery == 'email', permitting non-admin callers to use delivery == 'show' on verified-email collector accounts and receive the plaintext token at line 233.
Baseline comparison: may_issue_code() explicitly blocks non-admin code issuance when the target user has a verified email (sa.not_(verified_email)).

Baseline comparison: may_issue_code_from_data_management() enforces _outside_or_signed_in(target_user_id, projects) at line 312 to block non-admin issuance when the target belongs to an outside project or has a live phone session.
Policy section 8 specifies that Sign-In QR is emailed only to a verified email address or shown on screen once to an admin, and that an account without a verified email gets the on-screen delivery.

blockers: OS-enforced sandbox execution is unavailable on this VM (predeclared promotion allowlist is empty), preventing local runtime reproduction of POST /api/v1/users/<user_id>/sign-in-qr and POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in-qr/redeem against an isolated test database.

validation_plan.local: Run pytest inside an isolated test database (TEST_DATABASE_URL) with a test that authenticates as a non-admin project_pi or data_manager, creates or selects an active interviewer with email_verified=True, an active AuthDeviceSession (live phone), or a MapProjectMember row in another project, posts {'delivery': 'show'} to POST /api/v1/users/<user_id>/sign-in-qr, Assert HTTP 201 with a 'code' token, and posts that token to POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in-qr/redeem (including with replace_device_id at the 3-phone cap) to observe session issuance and device decommissioning.
validation_plan.deployment: Do not test exploit payloads on staging or production; inspect server configuration and audit logs (auth_security_events where event_type = 'sign_in_qr_issued' and detail->>'delivery' = 'show') to verify whether non-admin actors have issued on-screen Sign-In QRs for verified-email, live-phone, or cross-project collector accounts.
